title: AIFC — Auditable Independent-Future Challenge
description: A proof-carrying, adversarial scientific protocol for testing claims that exact information about independently generated future random events existed before target generation, with causal isolation, certified randomness, rollback-resistant provenance, Byzantine witness continuity, and anytime-valid statistics.
notes: AIFC does not report evidence of physical retrocausality, FTL communication, or closed timelike curves. Composition-level scientific novelty remains under review.
